resources.string: Continuously monitors the phone battery percentage at a user-selected threshold and synchronizes state and threshold alerts to the user’s paired Wear OS watch.
Shows when continuous phone battery monitoring is active.
Watching the phone battery at the %1$d%% threshold.
Alerts when the phone battery reaches the selected threshold.
It reached your %1$d%% threshold. Please charge your phone.
Keep watching the phone battery when this app is not visible. A low-priority ongoing notification provides a Stop action.
Monitoring could not restart automatically. Resume it while the app is open.
Choose whether continuous monitoring is active.
Monitoring could not start. Try again while the app is open.
Allow notifications to receive phone battery alerts and see continuous monitoring in the notification area. Monitoring, saving, and watch sync continue if you decline.
Notifications have not been requested. The system prompt appears only after you choose Allow notifications.
Notifications are not allowed. Change this choice in system notification settings; the app will not repeat the permission prompt.
Choose 5–100%. Changes are saved and synchronized only when you select Save.
The saved threshold is shown above.
Threshold saved and ready for watch sync.
Threshold saved. Use Sync now when the battery state is available.
Threshold saved, but watch sync failed. Use Sync now after reconnecting.
The phone is already at or below this threshold. No alert is created by this change; alerts resume after the battery rises above the re-arm level.
Phone battery alerts are unavailable because notifications are not allowed. Enable notifications in system settings.
The last phone battery alert could not be posted. Battery state and watch synchronization continue.
Battery state normally syncs to the paired watch automatically. Use Sync now if automatic sync does not occur or you want to refresh the latest state.
The current battery state is ready to sync with the watch.
Could not send the current battery state. Try again when the watch is connected.
The current battery state is unavailable.
The current battery reading was invalid and was not sent.
Notify this phone and the paired watch once when the phone reaches 100% in a charging session.
